Componenti OCR inclusi per il funzionamento offline della scansione scontrino:
- tesseract.js 7.0.0 e worker (Apache-2.0)            https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
- tesseract.js-core 7.0.0, build LSTM (Apache-2.0)    https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
- ita.traineddata (tessdata_best, versione "int")     https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best (Apache-2.0)
